enableIntro: Hidden Antwerp uses your location while this walking screen is open to:
enableReasonGuide: guide you to the next stop
privacy: Your exact location stays on this phone and is never stored. (The map loads the streets around you from OpenFreeMap.)
stayAware: Stay aware of traffic and your surroundings.
permissionBody: Without your location we can't show where you are; the map and the route stay visible.
permissionHelp: If your browser doesn't ask again, allow location for this site in your browser settings. Also check that location is switched on for your browser in your phone's settings.
notOnMap: This location isn't on the map yet.
mapUnavailable: The map couldn't be loaded (no connection, or this browser can't show maps). The directions and the external map still work.
mapTilesFailing: Part of the map can't be loaded right now (weak connection?). The directions below still work.
gpsUnavailable: GPS isn't available here. Location needs a secure (https) page and location services turned on.
gpsWeakDetail: Your position may be less accurate.

confirmArrival.title: Are you at {name}?
confirmArrival.message: Your GPS shows you're still about {distance} away. Continue to this stop anyway?

stillSearching: Still looking for your position. Outdoors, with a view of the sky, this goes faster.
